definitions.gloss: formal meeting for marriage, matchmaking, arranged introduction
definitions.explanation: A formal meeting arranged by a go-between or family members for the purpose of considering marriage. The prospective bride and groom meet, often with their families, to evaluate compatibility.

examples.japanese: {見合|みあ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: It was decided that I would have an arranged meeting.

examples.english: At my mother's recommendation, I met with the person from the arranged introduction.

notes:
USAGE:
{見合|みあ}い traditionally involves a ⟦{仲人|なこうど}→仲人：16691_nakoudo⟧ (go-between) who arranges the meeting and facilitates introductions. Modern {見合|みあ}い has evolved considerably and may be quite casual. The word contrasts with ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧ (romantic love) — marriages are often classified as either {見合|みあ}い⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (arranged marriage) or ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (love marriage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見合|みあ}い⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧: arranged marriage
- {見合|みあ}い⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: matchmaking partner
- {見合|みあ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have an arranged meeting
- {見合|みあ}い⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: photo used for matchmaking
